name: Opper
description: An EU-hosted multi-model gateway with selected free routes.
overview: Opper says free models work through its API immediately after signup without a card; its OpenAI-compatible guide explicitly identifies the gemini/gemma-4-31b route as free. Premium models need a card and credits. A numeric recurring quota and free-model duration were not found; no inference or signup was tested.
free_access: Selected free models available without a card
gemini/gemma-4-31b identified as a free route
Free allowance and duration not published
Premium models require card and credits
notes: Base URL https://api.opper.ai/v3/compat. Select the documented free route rather than a paid pool.
